decisions.cancel_condition: Cancel if the next completed H1 candle closes below 0.71235 before triggering; if price is already above 0.71350 when placing, skip rather than convert to a market buy.
decisions.exposure_note: Proposed AUD +0.25%, USD -0.25%. Only one new setup selected from the 16-symbol universe to avoid correlated USD-short stacking; server-side active-symbol, account-risk, and portfolio-exposure gates remain authoritative.
decisions.reasoning: AUDUSD recovered from the 06:00-08:00 base, held the 0.7123-0.7124 area through repeated tests, and the 13:00 H1 candle expanded bullishly to close near its high while breaking above the prior 0.71325 intraday resistance. A buy-stop at 0.71350 requires continuation beyond the fresh swing high instead of chasing inside the breakout candle. Other candidates were either more correlated, already represented by the prior EURJPY pending idea, or showed weaker/rejected structure.

message: Fresh MARKET_OPEN full-universe scan complete across all 16 reported symbols. AUDUSD is the cleanest new independent setup; correlated, rejected, or lower-quality candidates were excluded.
